description: metafun.md, published as server/current at 8.0, gates two EXTRACTDDL flag values (function, prepared) on Couchbase Server 8.0.1 - a release later than the page's own version. A reader on 8.0.0 is shown two flag values they cannot use, with no indication that the page is ahead of their build. Any model that assumes a page's own version is the floor for everything it documents breaks on this page.
